meta.author_theory: Mentions possible links to life experiences; wonders if there is psychology behind recurring futuristic mall dream worlds.

position.relative_to: Center of the areas I frequent; many dreams start here

qualities.raw_description: "There is a mall I'd say center of the areas I frequent"; "The mall is very big"; "does look futuristic"; shops incl. clothes stores; "even a grocery section"

position.relative_to: Inside the mall

qualities.raw_description: "2 story food court with elevators and escalaters"; "red staircase that swoops down in an oddly circular shape"; "a decent restaurant and a cool arcade"

position.relative_to: Somewhere in the food court

qualities.raw_description: "cool arcade"; "Lots of toys to be won that people carry around"

position.relative_to: In the mall

qualities.raw_description: "Theres even a grocery section."

position.relative_to: At the mall

qualities.raw_description: "a few acquaintances staring at a big fish tank"; "It was hypnotising"; "we were pulled through into another world"

position.relative_to: Entered after being pulled through fish tank

qualities.raw_description: "traveling through hallways, going room to room looking over our shoulder to try and get out of a large factory like building"

position.relative_to: Outside a door from the factory-like building

qualities.raw_description: "outside"; "feeling of being at war"; "needing to flee/hide from something that could be attacking from above"; "nothing was actually good cover"; "There was no plan to attack back or escape. Just, hopefully, survive."

position.relative_to: Part of the larger world; heads west through wooded area

qualities.raw_description: "There is a train"; "The train heads west through a wooded area"; "the train stops past the neighborhoods up on a hill"

position.relative_to: Along the train route west of the mall

qualities.raw_description: "often walking through the forest"; "I know the wooded area well"; "there it is always dusk"; "looking across a river over towards a big forested hill"; "understanding where I am in relation to where I am going"

position.relative_to: Through the forest, near neighborhoods; always night

qualities.raw_description: "Through the forest is a school and neighborhoods and it is always night. Ive not been in the school."

position.relative_to: Through the forest; before the train stop on a hill

qualities.raw_description: "The houses are very scary to me"; "Often I'll start my dream in one"; "walking through the neighborhood"; "feel compelled against my better judgement to enter"

position.relative_to: Inside the neighborhood

qualities.raw_description: "The houses feel huge once I am in them"; "easily I can get lost or disoriented"; "Each door leads to a different persona or emotion"; "Rather quickly, I'll want to leave but I don't think I have ever successfully done so"

position.relative_to: Past the neighborhoods, up on a hill; daytime

qualities.raw_description: "the train stops past the neighborhoods up on a hill"; "Where it stops it is day time"; "from the train stop it appears like a lovely world"; deceased grandma said "it was a place for us to meet and be"

position.relative_to: Taken from train stop/city routes; goes toward ocean to the east

qualities.raw_description: "more futuristic airplane like shuttle system"; "It's a bit snug once inside"; "dream me feels it quite the experience"; "will go to where the ocean is located to the east"

position.relative_to: First stop on shuttle on the way to the ocean

qualities.raw_description: "big city with lots of offices, restaurants, shops etc."; "Lots of fun things to do"; "fairly easy for me to navigate"

qualities.raw_description: "A bit beyond that is a beach near the ocean"; "A big tourist spot, lots of people"; "hotels and a recreational part for the beach with a walkway"; "fun day at the beach"

position.relative_to: At/near the beach tourist area

qualities.raw_description: "I stayed with my grandma at one of the hotels once"

position.relative_to: Near the beach/ocean

qualities.raw_description: "some sort of power plant... harnesses the energy of the waves"; "waves come crashing onto this big metallic structure"; "pretty cool to watch"

position.relative_to: In the city

qualities.raw_description: "In the city there is a library."

position.relative_to: At the back of the city library, through a door

qualities.raw_description: "door that leads to a cozier dark area which is lit with a crackling fireplace"; "couches and chairs"; "bookcases"; "particular couch... throw blanket and pillow"; "my 'home' spot"

locations.location_name: Older Asian library (hundreds of years ago)

position.relative_to: Woke up here after sleeping on couch in cozy library area

qualities.raw_description: "another library but obviously asian and from hundreds of years ago"; "needed to hurry to find a key"; fear that "the library or my ability to access it could be destroyed"; door "on the back left side"

locations.location_name: Cold lifeless dirt land with bookshelves (past/future books)

position.relative_to: Beyond the back-left door in the older Asian library

qualities.raw_description: "another world"; "silent" man present; "lifeless, almost desert, yet cold dirt land"; "couple book shelves"; "One held books from the past and one from the future"; instructed mentally: "take 3 books"

position.relative_to: Entered after choosing the third book (past life)

qualities.raw_description: "seemingly older Asian house somewhere in Asia"; laying on floor; could see outside; "admiring the beauty"; attended by a female; sense of being brought in "to die"; "final moments of comfort"; appreciated "smells, sounds, visuals"

interactions.description: Wandered the shops, looking at things (often clothes stores).
Saw acquaintances staring at a big fish tank; joined them; the tank was "hypnotising."
After staring at the fish tank, "we were pulled through into another world."
Traveled through hallways and rooms, looking over shoulder, trying to get out of a large factory-like building.
Constantly tried to run to cover after a building seemed to be attacked; knew "nothing was actually good cover"; no plan to fight back or escape, just survive.

entities_involved.description: something that could be attacking from above

interactions.transaction_blocker: No cover was actually good cover; survival-only situation

interactions.description: While walking through the neighborhood, felt compelled (against better judgement) to enter scary houses.
Wanted to leave the huge house after entering; tried to find an exit from rooms/conversations; reports never successfully leaving in any dream.
interactions.transaction_blocker: Unable to find/achieve an exit; house layout/doors lead to different personas/emotions

interactions.description: Listened to others' anger or sadness; communication occurred but unsure if words were spoken out loud.
Met deceased grandma at the train stop; she explained it was a place for them to meet and be; occasionally meet for a day of bonding.
Uses a particular couch with a throw blanket and pillow; often falls asleep/rests there and wakes up by falling asleep.
Felt need to hurry to find a key to open a door on the back-left side of the older Asian library; feared loss of library/access if too slow; knew where key was and retrieved it.

Silent man communicated mentally that the dreamer could take 3 books; dreamer took 3 books from the past shelf (one representing the man; one enabling return; one to go back to a particular past life).

entities_involved.description: silent man; "I've seen him before"; communicated in mind

interactions.description: Was a man (dream identity) lying on a floor with an abdominal wound; knew dying; could not get all the way up; felt comfort and attended by a female; appreciated smells/sounds/visuals; eventually died and woke up.

entities_involved.description: female attending to wounds; heard her walking/doing things

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes a long-term recurring coherent dream-world with multiple regions (mall core, west forest/night neighborhoods/day hill stop, east city/beach/ocean, library sub-areas, portal transitions). Some qualities (lighting temperature, cleanliness, crowding) are only specified for certain locations (forest dusk; neighborhoods night; train stop daytime; fireplace room warm/dim; beach crowded).
